body.heading: Choose the moment
paragraphs: Think of a time your person was kind: sharing, helping, comforting, cheering you on.
Picture the moment like a photograph in your head.

body.heading: Draw and give
paragraphs: Draw the moment as well as you can. It does not need to look real to feel real.
Give the picture to your person and tell them why you chose that moment.

takeaway: Drawing someone kindly is a way of looking at them with love.
safetyNotes: Draw from memory or with the person happily sitting with you.
screenFreeExtension: Draw yourself doing something kind, to remind yourself what you can do.
